title: Likes, dislikes, attitudes and preferences
title_uz: Yoqtirish, yoqtirmaslik, munosabat va afzal ko‘rish

words.ex: My little brother is really into robots and spends every Saturday at a robotics club.
I'm not a big fan of spicy food, but I quite like the lagman at the café near our school.
Kamila isn't very keen on swimming, so she sat by the pool with a book while we swam.
My older sister can't stand waiting in queues, so she pays for everything online.
When I was little, I really disliked carrots, but now I eat them in salads every day.
'I love watching football on TV.' 'Oh, so do I! Let's watch the final together.'
'I'm really hungry after that long walk.' 'Yes, so am I. Let's find a café.'

words.uz: Men ham emas («I’m not…» kabi gapga)
words.ex: 'I'm not very good at drawing.' 'Don't worry, neither am I.'

words.uz: Men ham qila olmayman («I can’t…» ga)
words.ex: 'I can't swim very well.' 'No, neither can I, so let's stay in the shallow end.'
'I don't really like cold weather.' 'Really? Oh, me neither; I prefer summer.'
Since he joined the school chess club, my brother's attitude to maths has completely changed.
Our neighbour used to work in a bank, but now he runs a small café in Margilan.
My sister is very interested in old buildings, so she loved our trip to Khiva.
On the class website, every student wrote a short paragraph about their family and interests.
The baby cried the whole journey, so I didn't sleep at all on the night bus to Termez.
The twins look exactly the same, but they have nothing in common: Hasan loves sport and Husan hates it.
Ziyoda and her new classmate have a lot in common: they both play the piano and love cats.
The first week at the new school was hard, but I soon got used to the long days.
Our neighbour prefers the train to the plane because he likes looking out of the window.
'We can have pizza or soup for dinner.' 'Hmm, I'd prefer to have the soup; it's cold tonight.'
'I've already finished my maths homework.' 'Really? Me too! Let's go and play outside.'
My little sister loves horses and draws them on every page of her notebooks.
'Do you like my new haircut?' Laylo asked. 'Yes, it's really nice!'
Football isn't my favourite sport, but I don't mind watching it with my friends on Sundays.
History lessons never used to interest me, but our new teacher makes them exciting.
